candidate_words: all 10 cyclic rotations of the certified 10-token word, including the original as control
semantics: original stored binary64 parameters interpreted as exact rationals for proof; float64 simulation only for screening
frozen_hypothesis: At least one nonidentity cyclic rotation violates abs(output-6)<=0.1 by 2048 repetitions although the original is proven correct for all repetitions.
primary_scalar: number of nonidentity rotations failing by repetition 2048
success_criterion: at least one rotation fails and original passes; at least one failing rotation independently checked and exact-rationally certified
baseline_competitor: cyclic permutations may share sufficient balanced-counting dynamics; 32-cycle linear drift may already predict every failure
independent_check: independent Decimal or direct NumPy replay plus exact rational inequality for a selected witness
no_peeking: No evaluation beyond the 32-cycle horizon before protocol commit. The word family and success criterion are frozen before running full-horizon simulations.
claim_boundary: word-specific phase sensitivity in one unchanged gradient-trained checkpoint, not an algorithm-acquisition law
kill_condition: If no rotation fails by 2048, retire cyclic-phase adversary on this checkpoint and retain negative.
